bluetooth_method.title: Add {name}
bluetooth_method.description:
**[Scan with the camera]({scan_url})** · **[Pick a photo]({photo_url})** of the QR code on the EnOcean module label, behind the rocker. Its address must be {mac}.

Or paste the QR code text, or use the button sequence.

data.qr_code: Or paste the QR code text
data.button_sequence: Or use the button sequence (manual commissioning)

data_description.button_sequence: For a switch whose label you cannot reach. Some OEM switches (for example Busch-Jaeger, Jung) do not support it.

commissioning.title: EnOcean BLE Auto-Commissioning
commissioning.description:
Activate auto-commissioning on {name}:

1. Hold button 1 for 7 seconds
2. Press button 1 briefly
3. Hold button 1 again for 7 seconds

You have 2 minutes. Retry if needed.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm EnOcean BLE Device
bluetooth_confirm.description:
EnOcean switch with address {mac} was commissioned successfully.

⚠️ Press another button to disable commissioning mode, then click Submit.

commissioning_retry.title: Commissioning did not succeed
commissioning_retry.description: No valid commissioning telegram was received from {name}. Try again, or go back and add it from the QR code on its module label. If commissioning keeps failing, read the factory reset disclaimer in the documentation first.

progress.waiting_commissioning: Hold button 1 for 7 seconds, then press button 1 briefly, and hold again for 7 seconds.

abort.no_bluetooth_discovery: This setup must start from a discovered Bluetooth device.
abort.not_enocean_prefix: This discovered device does not use the EnOcean BLE MAC prefix (E2:15).
abort.discovery_required: Press any button on the switch: it then appears as a discovered device in Settings → Devices & services, where you can add it.

error.invalid_qr: No EnOcean switch address (30SE215…) and 32-character security key (+Z…) were found in this text.
error.commissioning_not_detected: No commissioning telegram was received within 2 minutes. Try again. If it still does not work after multiple attempts, you can try a factory reset. Please read the reset disclaimer in the documentation first.
error.invalid_commissioning: A commissioning telegram was received but could not be validated. Try again. If this keeps failing, review the factory reset disclaimer in the documentation before resetting.
error.qr_mac_mismatch: This QR code belongs to another switch than the one that was discovered.
error.qr_key_invalid: The key in this QR code does not match the telegrams received from this switch. It may have been reconfigured (for example by another system).
error.qr_no_telegram: No telegram has been received from this switch yet. Press one of its buttons, then try again.
error.choose_method: Scan or paste the QR code, or turn on the button sequence.
